subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw provide a distinct ordered fallback-chain probe, and if so should it extend `models status --probe` rather than add a parallel `/models test-fallback` command?
rationale: The overlapping per-model-health proposal can validate individual configured models but does not settle whether operators need a true ordered failover simulation, nor which public command surface should own it.

options.title: Extend the status probe
options.body: Add an explicit fallback-chain mode to the existing CLI status/probe surface, preserving one diagnostics entry point while documenting probe ordering and cost.

options.title: Add a slash-command workflow
options.body: Keep the existing status probe unchanged and add an interactive `/models` command for active-agent fallback verification.

options.title: Defer to per-model health checks
options.body: Land only independent configured-model probes and leave ordered fallback simulation out of the product unless real incidents prove that gap.

recommendation.title: Extend the status probe
recommendation.body: Add an explicit fallback-chain mode to the existing CLI status/probe surface, preserving one diagnostics entry point while documenting probe ordering and cost.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and prior model-status/fallback review evidence make this person the strongest available routing candidate for the diagnostic contract.
